**Yes, DonorDock provides online giving functionality through customizable donation pages and forms.**[1][2][3]

These pages integrate with Stripe and PayPal (or Square via Zapier) to process one-time gifts, recurring donations, memberships, event tickets, pledges, sponsorships, honorariums, memorials, and anonymous gifts, with all transactions automatically recorded in your DonorDock account in real time.[1][3][7]

Key features include:
- Unlimited branded pages for campaigns, appeals, events, or general giving, which are mobile-friendly and embeddable on websites.[1][4][7]
- Options like text-to-donate (via keyword to your DonorDock phone number), QR codes for scan-to-donate, and DAFpay for Donor-Advised Fund gifts.[1][4]
- Secure processing with encrypted connections, SOC II certification, and a 1% platform fee on donations.[1]
- Full access to features requires Stripe Connect as the payment processor.[3]

Pages are created via the Online Giving section in DonorDock, with global settings and detailed management for reporting, contacts, gifts, and automation.[2][4][6]
